how: Each of the 46 rows a batch Google Maps run (2026-11-24) flagged as closed was opened again in Google Maps in headless Chromium (2026-11-24, limited view, no reviews tab), with the row's own map query, then the local name or another name of the place; a list result read when Maps gave a list. Where Maps showed 'Temporarily closed', or where the closed listing might be another place, one web search or the place's own site decided. Removed: Maps 'Permanently closed' on the place itself, or a source saying closed for good, closed with no reopening date, or abandoned. Kept: Maps landed on a stale or other listing, or nothing but the Maps label said closed. Season notes where the closure is the season.

rows.name: Al Ittihad Park
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Al Ittihad Park · Park · Temporarily closed'. A post on the park's fate says it is being redeveloped as a programme of 'improvements' and 'local residents … have been fenced out'; no reopening date anywhere.

rows.name: Drukgyel Dzong ruins
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Drukgyal Dzong · Historical landmark · Temporarily closed', no notice. The dzong has been rebuilt since 2016 (BBS); a 2026 guide says the rebuild is finished and the outside can be seen. No source says it is closed to visitors. Unsure: the row still calls it ruins.

rows.name: Light Rail Line 2 at Liziba Station
rows.evidence: The closed listing 'Liziba station · Permanently closed' is a stale entry with no category or hours; the working listing 'Liziba Viewing Platform 李子坝观景平台 · 景点' has no closure. The map query now points to the viewing platform.

rows.name: Harbin Polarland
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Harbin Polarland 哈尔滨极地馆 · Temporarily closed', no notice. Ctrip lists it open 09:00–17:00 (last entry 16:30); Xinhua (July 2026) reports new penguins arriving at Harbin Polarland Park. No closure notice found.

rows.name: Kids SoHo Playground
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Kids SoHo Playground · Playground · Temporarily closed' at Jl. Bypass Ngurah Rai No.278, no notice. Its own site (kids-soho.com) shows no closure; a June 2026 playground guide still lists it. Unsure: nothing dated confirms it open.

rows.name: Aqaba Aquarium (Marine Science Station)
rows.evidence: Maps: 'محطة العلوم البحرية · Museum · Temporarily closed', no notice. The station's own aquarium page and Aqaba's official tourism site still present the aquarium; no closure reported. Unsure: nothing dated confirms it open.

rows.name: Toyota Mega Web
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Megaweb Toyota City Showcase · Permanently closed' (it closed on 31 Dec 2021 for the Odaiba redevelopment).

rows.name: Takino Suzuran Hillside National Park
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Temporarily closed'. The 2026 summer season ran 19 Apr–10 Nov; the winter Takino Snow World ran 23 Dec–31 Mar; closed between. Tip now names the gap and the seasons.

rows.name: Sapporo Teine Snow Land
rows.evidence: Maps list: 'Sapporo Teine Ski Area · Ski resort · Temporarily closed' (off season). The 2025–26 season ran 22 Nov 2025–6 May 2026. Tip now says the snow season only, about late Nov to early May.

rows.name: Kumamoto Castle Museum Wakuwakuza
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Temporarily closed'. The row's tip already says it closed after the July 2026 earthquake with reopening planned for December 2026.

rows.name: Ikenotaira Family Land
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Ikenotaira Family Land · Amusement park · Temporarily closed'. Its 2026 season ran 18 Apr–23 Nov; closed in winter from mid-Nov to late Apr. Tip now names the season.

rows.name: Minogahara Forest Park
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Temporarily closed'. The row's tip already says 'Closed in winter'.

rows.name: Nature Discovery Center of Cambodia
rows.evidence: Maps: 'The Nature Discovery Center of Cambodia - By Fauna in Focus · Permanently closed'.

rows.name: Hwangnyongsa Temple History and Culture Hall
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Hwangnyongsa History & Culture Hall · Temporarily closed', no notice. Kyongbuk Maeil (July 2026) recommends it as an indoor rainy-day sight of the Gyeongbuk tourism body; no closure notice found.

rows.name: Happylon family amusement park
rows.evidence: Maps: both Astana listings, 'Happylon Pirate's Park · Children's amusement center · Permanently closed' (3CQ5+MMF) and the one at Mega, 'Permanently closed'.

rows.name: Tad Sae Waterfalls
rows.evidence: Maps list: 'Tat Sae Waterfalls · Tourist attraction · Temporarily closed'. No official notice; one listing says 'technically closed' with local boats still going, tour operators sell 2026–27 trips. Unsure.

rows.name: Pha Tad Ke Botanical Garden
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Pha Tad Ke Botanical Garden · Permanently closed'. Its own site: it closed during the COVID-19 lockdowns, could not reopen for lack of funding, 'we are now definitely closed'.

rows.name: Nam Dong Park
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Nahm Dong Park · Permanently closed' (searched as the row's query and as 'Nahm Dong Park Luang Prabang').

rows.name: Merenid Tombs viewpoint
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Marinid Tombs · Historical landmark · Temporarily closed', no notice; an open hilltop ruin. No closure or restoration of the tombs reported (only other medina works). Unsure: Maps label unexplained.

rows.name: Studio City Water Park
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Temporarily closed'. The official site closes only the outdoor area, 2 Nov 2026–29 Apr 2027; the indoor park stays open all year. The row's tip already says the outdoor area is closed November to April.

rows.name: Go Airborne
rows.evidence: Maps: 'GoAirborne Indoor Skydiving Macau · Permanently closed'.

rows.name: Sabah State Museum and Heritage Village
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Sabah State Museum · Temporarily closed', while 'Bryde's Whale Skeleton · Open · Closes 5 PM', 'Cafe Muzium · Open', 'Heritage Village Phase 2' listed at the same place. A guide: the main building is closed for upgrading until further notice, the heritage village and locomotive gallery stay open. Tip now says so.

rows.name: Kipandi Butterfly Park
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Kipandi Park · Permanently closed'.

rows.name: Perdana Marine Park
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Langkawi Marine Park · Permanently closed', Jalan Pantai Kok, Perdana Quay — the row's place.

rows.name: Sagbayan Peak
rows.evidence: Maps list: 'Sagbayan Peak · Tourist attraction · Permanently closed', 'Sagbayan Peak Park · Permanently closed', 'Sagbayan Peak View Deck · Temporarily closed'.

rows.name: Mount Luho viewing deck
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Mt. Luho View Deck · Permanently closed' (the mountain itself is a separate listing with no deck hours); a guide says the older viewpoint is closed for maintenance.

rows.name: Happy Dreamland Theme Park
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Happy Dream Land Boracay · Permanently closed'.

rows.name: Yoyoland, Seacon Square
rows.evidence: Maps: 'YoYo Land Seacon Square Srinakarin · Temporarily closed', no notice; no closure reported by the mall or the press. Unsure: nothing dated confirms it open.

rows.name: Rawai Park
rows.evidence: Maps owner's post: 'Rawai Park – Closed for Improvements Starting November 2026 … Stay tuned to our social media channels for reopening updates' — no reopening date.

rows.name: Harborland
rows.evidence: Maps list: 'HarborLand · Indoor playground · ชั้น 4 ศูนย์การค้าเทอร์มินอล 21 พัทยา · Open · Closes 8 PM'; the closed listing is the mall 'Harbor Pattaya · Shopping mall · Temporarily closed'. Area, text and map query now point to the Terminal 21 playground (the row already named it).

rows.name: The Fun Garden
rows.evidence: Maps: 'The Fun Garden · Permanently closed'.

rows.name: Ayutthaya Historical Study Centre
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Ayutthaya Historical Study Center · Permanently closed'. News (July 2026): the centre has stood abandoned since 2019; repairs are being discussed for 2027, no reopening date.

rows.name: Jim Thompson Farm
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Temporarily closed', owner's update: 'Jim Thompson Farm … as we prepare to welcome visitors again in the future. Jim Thompson Farm is clos[ed]' — no season or date given.

rows.name: Hug You Sheep Farm
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Hug You Sheep Farm ฟาร์มแกะฮักยู ลำปาง · Permanently closed'.

rows.name: Satun Geopark Museum
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Thung Wa Ancient Elephant Museum · พิพิธภัณฑ์อุทยานธรณีสตูล · Permanently closed' — the geopark museum itself. A separate open listing 'ศูนย์วัฒนธรรมเฉลิมราช พิพิธภัณฑ์ช้างดึกดำบรรพ์ทุ่งหว้า' exists but no page ties it to this museum.

rows.name: Loei Museum
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Loei Museum · Permanently closed' with no other detail, but Daily News (12 Dec 2025) reports an exhibition on the ground floor of the Loei City Museum building, open 12 Dec 2025–10 Jan 2026 daily except Mondays, the governor touring its second floor. Unsure: no later source.

rows.name: The Land Crack
rows.evidence: Maps: 'แผ่นดินแยก ปาย · Permanently closed' ('Pai Land Split' not found on Maps). A July 2026 aggregator guide still describes it; no source answers the Maps label, so the rule's 'Permanently closed on this place' decides.

rows.name: Namtok Sunantha (Khao Nan National Park)
rows.evidence: The flagged listing is the national park office ('Khao Nan National Park · Temporarily closed'); the waterfall's own listing 'Namtok Su Nan Tha น้ำตกสุนันทา · Open · Closes 4:30 PM'.

rows.name: Tai Rom Yen National Park (Namtok Dat Fa)
rows.evidence: The park listing says 'Temporarily closed', but at the same place 'Dat Fa Waterfall · Tourist attraction · Open · Closes 4:30 PM' — the row's waterfall.

rows.name: Udon Sunshine Orchid Garden
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Udon Sunshine Orchid · Orchid farm · Temporarily closed'; visitor reviews say the orchids can no longer be viewed by the public; no reopening found.

rows.name: Suan Lung Thong Bai fruit orchard
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Suan Lung Tongbai สวนลุงทองใบ · Orchard · Temporarily closed', no notice; an orchard visited in fruit season and the row's tip already says to phone first about what is ripe. Unsure: no 2026 source either way.

rows.name: Rayong Aquarium
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Rayong Aquarium สถานแสดงพันธุ์สัตว์น้ำระยอง · Temporarily closed'. Listings: 'temporarily closed for structural repairs', a closure for renovation announced for at least two years, no reopening date.

rows.name: Halıcı Ahmet Urkay Museum
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Halıcı Ahmet Urkay Arkeoloji & Etnografya Müzesi · Permanently closed'.

rows.name: Beitou Hot Spring Museum
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Beitou Hot Spring Museum · Temporarily closed'. Beitou Museum's stamp-walk page: the Hot Spring Museum is closed from 9 Nov 2026, its stamp moved to Plum Garden and passport sales stopped; no reason or reopening date given.

rows.name: PaPark Dream Mall
rows.evidence: Maps: 'PaPark爬爬客親子樂園-高雄夢時代店 · Permanently closed'.

rows.name: Vietnam National Museum of History
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Temporarily closed'. The museum's own notice: the permanent exhibition at 01 Trang Tien closed from 15 Dec 2025 for the Renovation and Upgrade Project (groundbreaking 19 Dec 2025), no reopening date; visitors are sent to 216 Tran Quang Khai.
